info.title: Upload Assistant API
info.description: Local-first Chinese PT retorrent automation with durable steps, rule gates, and auditable evidence.

200.description: Redacted in-app and external delivery audit

get.description: Downloads only non-secret evidence kinds after size and SHA-256 verification. Source, generated, and downloaded torrent payloads are always denied.

200.description: Site adapters and active rule fingerprints
Credential disabled without deleting encrypted history
Remote downloaders with redacted credential metadata

get.description: Authoritative native runtime capability catalog. Adapters with runtime_supported=false may only be saved disabled.

200.description: Torrent state and mapped path evidence
Notification channels with credential field names only
Sonarr and Radarr instances with credential field names only

get.description: Parses only a single Python config literal from the fixed read-only legacy mount. Python is never executed and secret values are never returned.

200.description: Redacted migration preview and source fingerprint
Redacted migration history and encrypted archive retention state

post.description: Imports a previously reviewed exact fingerprint. No external service is contacted and original files are never modified or deleted.

200.description: An identical completed import returned idempotently without resource writes

fingerprint.description: Master-keyed HMAC; never a plain hash of secret-bearing source content.

source_fingerprint.description: Exact master-keyed HMAC-SHA256 returned by preview; not a plain source hash.

archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 over encrypted archive metadata and ciphertext, never the plaintext archive.

evidence.description: Non-empty per-job human evidence is required for blocking manual obligations.

target_downloader.description: Target seeding settings. Defaults to the source downloader and the verified parent save path; skip_checking and paused must remain false.

confirm_upload.description: A later live target upload gate requires an explicit true value; it is never inferred.

save_path.description: Normalized absolute path as seen by the remote downloader.

apply_labels.description: Explicitly set false for an adapter whose capability reports category=false or tags=false; category and tags must then be empty.

RetorrentDownloader.description: Source-download or target-seeding settings. An active site rule revision can impose a stricter rate cap, which always wins. Target injection always requires skip_checking=false and paused=false. apply_labels=false is an explicit audited omission for capability-limited adapters and cannot be combined with category or tags. These fields can also be supplied in resume_state after a configuration block.

profile.description: Latest enabled immutable screenshot profile revision.

SubmitDailyCandidateRequest.description: This request deliberately has no accept_rules or confirm_upload fields. The created retorrent job must satisfy those gates later.

notification_channels.description: Existing enabled channels explicitly selected for this schedule.

category.description: Current MTEAM category id when the adapter cannot infer it safely.

category_evidence.description: Human-readable reason or current category-page evidence for an explicit category.

standard.description: MTEAM resolution id; normally derived from MediaInfo.

imdb_id.description: Explicit reviewed identity only when the immutable target package has no IMDb link. A conflicting value is blocked and cannot replace package identity.

input_snapshot.description: The raw durable snapshot is never returned. The API exposes only {redacted:true,sha256:<digest>}.

credentials.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned.

apply_labels.description: Must be explicitly false, with empty category/tags, when adapter capabilities do not support labels.

download_limit.description: Bytes per second; zero disables the limit.

upload_limit.description: Bytes per second; zero disables the limit.

credentials.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned.

width.description: Omit or use 0 to preserve source width.
